corrections.method: Read the same untouched original DWG with ACadSharp and match dynamic objects by handle.
findings: Polar distance/angle labels and two value sets verified from original bytes; LibreDWG names reversed and duplicate JSON keys lost one set.
Linear distance / rotation angle fields are LabelOffset rather than parameter values; default dimensions derived from definition geometry.
Stretch/Move use DistanceMultiplier + AngleOffset + byte; LibreDWG third BD read crossed object payload.
Actual ScaleType, entity selection, stretch vertex bindings and source connections restored.
